description: This file implements the '--no-index' functionality for 'git diff', handling command-line parsing, directory traversal, and diff computation outside a git repository. It provides functions for reading directory contents, processing special path cases, and performing recursive diff operations between arbitrary filesystem paths.

methods.name: int read_directory_contents(const char * path,struct string_list * list,const struct pathspec * pathspec,struct strbuf * match)
methods.description: Reads the contents of a directory, applying pathspec filtering, and adds filenames to a string list.

methods.name: int get_mode(const char * path,int * mode,enum special * special)
methods.description: Determines the mode and type of a given filesystem path, handling special cases like stdin, pipes, and null device.

methods.name: void populate_common(struct diff_filespec * s,struct strbuf * buf)
methods.description: Initializes a diff_filespec structure with data from a strbuf.

methods.name: void populate_from_pipe(struct diff_filespec * s)
methods.description: Reads data from a pipe file descriptor into a diff_filespec.

methods.name: void populate_from_stdin(struct diff_filespec * s)
methods.description: Reads data from standard input into a diff_filespec.

methods.name: struct:diff_filespec * noindex_filespec(const struct git_hash_algo * algop,const char * name,int mode,enum special special)
methods.description: Creates a diff_filespec for a path outside the git index, handling special cases.

methods.name: int queue_diff(struct diff_options * o,const struct git_hash_algo * algop,const char * name1,const char * name2,int recursing,const struct pathspec * ps,struct strbuf * ps_match1,struct strbuf * ps_match2)
methods.description: Recursively queues diffs between two filesystem paths, handling directories and files.

methods.name: void append_basename(struct strbuf * path,const char * dir,const char * file)
methods.description: Appends the basename of a file path to a directory path.

methods.name: int fixup_paths(const char ** path,struct strbuf * replacement)
methods.description: Adjusts paths for comparison, appending basenames if comparing directories.

methods.name: int diff_no_index(struct rev_info * revs,const struct git_hash_algo * algop,int implicit_no_index,int argc,const char ** argv)
methods.description: Main function that processes command-line arguments and performs '--no-index' diffs outside a git repository.
